extra.reason: Added flutter_contacts ^1.1.9+2 dependency, NSContactsUsageDescription to ios/Info.plist, ContactImportService abstract interface + FlutterContactImportService concrete impl, ImportableContact value model, ContactPermissionStatus enum, contactImportServiceProvider Riverpod provider. 8 unit tests covering model + provider; concrete OS-boundary impl follows haptic_service pattern (untested at unit level).

ContactImporter service with field mapping (name, phone[0], email[0], birthday, jobTitle, thumbnail), duplicate detection (phone OR email match, name fallback), skip/update strategies, optional circle assignment, AvatarStore abstraction with FilesAvatarStore impl using path_provider, ImportConfig + ImportResult value types. 13 unit tests cover all behaviors. Note: per-contact ops are not yet wrapped in a transaction (orphans possible if a step fails mid-import); imported contacts have is_dirty=true so future sync would reconcile.
